correctStatements.text: At 05:55 m.abdullahi reported search errors on the Irish storefront with the cluster status red.
Siobhan saw three data nodes at 96% disk.
tariq-rahman found that the full reindex started at 04:30 and duplicated the 420 GB index.
At 06:07 Siobhan cancelled the reindex task.
At 06:11 tariq-rahman deleted the half-built index to free space.
At 06:17 Siobhan saw disk at 58% with shards reallocating.
At 06:26 m.abdullahi saw the cluster yellow and searches working again.
At 06:33 catalogue-search-relevance-and-infra-guild told merchandising the new ranking would wait until next week.
At 06:45 m.abdullahi saw the cluster turn green.
catalogue-search-relevance-and-infra-guild said search was down or partial for about 65 minutes.
Action item: reindex into a new index only after a free-space check, owner tariq-rahman.
Action item: alert at 80% disk on data nodes, owner Siobhan.
